messages:
Anya: Quick check — CI flakes in eu-west1 demo pool. Seeing ~5 H100 nodes with firmware 2.3.1 while the rest are 2.2.9. PyTorch smoke tests hit kernel panics. Is this a vendor rollout?
Devin: Hmm, I saw a maint notice overnight but assumed it was packaging. Do you have node IDs / sample logs?
Anya: Sample from failing pod:
```
Node: gke-eu-demo-h100-12
nv_firmware: 2.3.1
error: cuBLAS init panic / SIGSEGV
```
Failing suite: nightly/pytorch-smoke, batch size 4.
Samir: Tagging @Maria for quota/standby pools. Can we spin A100 fallback for CI?
Maria: I can request soft-standby but need count + duration. How many slots?
Anya: Need 6 A100s for ~4 hours to clear the CI backlog.
OpsBot: Detect: job #3129 had node-label mismatch; auto-fallback disabled. See https://ci.internal/jobs/3129
Devin: I'll open a vendor ticket and ping our contact. If it's rolling FW, we should canary.
Samir: Short term: can we node-select away from nodes with `nv_firmware=2.3.1`? e.g.
```
spec:
  nodeSelector:
    nv_firmware: "2.2.9"
```
Anya: Tried that; scheduler still puts some pods on mixed nodes (labels not uniform). Need taint+toleration.
Samir: On it — will taint flagged nodes with `firmware=unverified:NoSchedule` and add tolerations for known-good ones.
Maria: Procurement: I'll file an internal request for 6 A100 soft slots once ops confirms pool name. ETA ~30m for approval.
Devin: Vendor replied (ticket VND-9876): "We're doing a staged FW update across EU racks. Expected finish in ~2h. Some kernel combos may regress briefly; monitoring now."
Anya: OK. I'll pause the nightly matrix until A100s or taint is live. Please ping when taint + pool are ready.
Samir: Taint applied to 5/6 flagged nodes, one pending remove. Requeuing affected pods now.
Maria: Procurement approved, allocating pool `eu-a100-standby` x6. IAM creds being provisioned.
Anya: Tests passing on A100 standby — reinstating nightly. Will draft a short postmortem tomorrow if we see any regression traces. :thumbsup:
Devin: I'll add a fleet-monitor alert for firmware drift (threshold: >2 nodes with different nv_firmware in a zone).
OpsBot: Auto: incident closed (no customer impact).
